title: Understanding Spectral Clustering
text: Spectral clustering involves transforming the data into a new space using eigenvectors of a matrix derived from the data. Once in this new space, a clustering algorithm is applied to group the data points.

title: Choosing the Right Clustering Algorithm
text: After transforming the data into spectral coordinates, we need a clustering algorithm that can effectively partition the data into distinct groups. Consider algorithms that are commonly used for partitioning data into a specified number of clusters.

title: Applying Clustering to Spectral Coordinates
text: Which clustering algorithm is typically used after calculating spectral coordinates to determine the clusters?
